items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: I had one for that Connler.

ctx.x: He never did tell me. He just tell me I'm going to get a job and say, if you don't believe, come with me now. Sure you're not. But I knew he was using something. I knew he was using something. He didn't walk up and get a job that easy. Yeah. Right. These brass bands, were they your bands?
Did you organize them or did you play in other people's bands too? Well, I had one myself. You had one? I had one for that Connler. I had one for that Connler.
I didn't have one like, I mean like the old Tuxedo and them bands. They were standard bands. But I had one every year when we get there for a parade, I had one ready. See, I know.
